title: SideFX circuit workbench: source inspection · Inspector on the left, inspection above the circuit
note: The M1 recreation of the supplied workbench, declared rather than coded. Every control recorded in fixtures/baseline/control-behavior.json is declared here as a semantic component with its state, binding and action, so that the browser receives a lowered interaction plan instead of page handlers. The circuit itself is a `circuit` component: componentType is deliberately an open string in this authority, and a provider profile declares which types it can realize, so an unrealizable circuit is a visible projection finding rather than a silently flattened image. Nothing here names a framework, and nothing here invokes a capability: every action names a scenario event without crossing the execution boundary. Derived by layout profile inspector-left: The plan requires proving that relocating the inspector and changing the theme preserves action and source identity. This profile declares only region movement and sizing. It may not add, remove or rename a component, state, binding, validation rule or action — the deriver refuses if the derived surface differs from its basis in any of those sets.
